PayButton is a digital payment service allowing consumers to register and store their discover issued payment cards and then use them to perform ecommerce and m-commerce transactions. This service is accessible using a Discove-pay button, which can be integrated by prospective merchants on their existing web pages for web browsers or mobile-based browsers. Paybutton will allow merchants to use their existing web pages and partnership with their payment process.
Responsibilities:
